run_outcome.prospective_forecast_status: Not evaluated: load was stopped before the first forecast window; do not score cooldown as continued-load forecasting error

purpose: Frozen descriptive model comparison; not physical parameter identification or a temperature safety limit
sensor: CPU Tctl, median of five-minute windows
validation_rules: Use CPU medians over windows centered on forecast times, e.g. 117.5 through122.5 minutes for the120-minute prediction.
Only assess heating forecasts while the original run and comparable power continue; a temperature cutoff or workload/cooling intervention invalidates the continuation assumption.
Record errors against these frozen parameters before any refit.
Neither a good fit nor a slow pole alone locates the thermal state in room air, coolant or hardware.
The last input median was from an almost-complete five-minute window (291 samples) when queried.
